article.title: Why Writing Down the Next Step Saves Time
article.why: 用簡單英文學習如何降低工作中斷後的重新進入成本。
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
When you stop working on a task, write down the next physical step before you leave it. The note can be very short: ‘Check row 18,’ ‘Call Mia about the price,’ or ‘Add the chart to slide four.’ This small habit can save time when you return.

Without a note, you must first remember where you were. You may open several files, read old messages, or repeat work that you already finished. This is especially common when a task is interrupted by a meeting, lunch, another request, or the end of the day. Your brain has to rebuild the context before it can continue.

A next-step note makes that restart easier. It tells you where to begin, so you can move from thinking about the task to doing the task. The best note describes an action, not a general goal. ‘Continue the report’ is not very useful. ‘Write the paragraph that explains the sales drop’ is much clearer.

This habit also helps when you have many small tasks. Before closing a document, write one next action in the document, your task list, or a short note. You do not need a complicated system. The value comes from leaving yourself a clear starting point.

Sometimes the next step will change. That is fine. The note is not a promise. It is a bridge between one work session and the next. If new information arrives, you can update the step.

Try it today with one unfinished task. Before you switch to something else, write the next action in one sentence. Tomorrow, open the task and follow the note. You may notice that the first few minutes feel easier because you do not have to ask, ‘What was I doing?’ The note has already answered that question.

It can also help teammates during handovers. A visible next step shows what remains, even if another person must continue the work.
paragraphs.zh: 當你暫停一項工作時，在離開前寫下下一個具體動作。沒有筆記時，重新開始往往要先重建脈絡；清楚的 next step 可以直接告訴你從哪裡繼續。最好寫具體行動，而不是模糊目標，例如把『繼續做報告』改成『寫出解釋銷售下降原因的那一段』。這個方法不需要複雜系統，也能讓交接更順暢。
paragraphs.ja: 作業を中断するときは、離れる前に次の具体的な行動を書いておきます。再開時に文脈を思い出す負担が減り、『レポートを続ける』より『売上減少を説明する段落を書く』のような明確な一手から始められます。複雑な仕組みは不要で、引き継ぎにも有効です。

phrases.example: Write down the next step before switching tasks.
Leave yourself a clear starting point.

grammar.title: Before + V-ing
grammar.body: Before closing a document 表示在關閉文件之前。

business.term: What is the next concrete action?
business.explanation: 把模糊工作轉成可執行下一步
business.example: Before we stop, what is the next concrete action?

business.term: I’ll leave the next step in the note.
business.explanation: 交接時說明已留下下一步
business.example: I’ll leave the next step in the note for tomorrow.

quiz.question: Why does a next-step note save time?
quiz.answer: Because it reduces the need to rebuild context when you restart.

quiz.question: Output: Rewrite a vague task as one specific next step.
quiz.answer: Example: Replace ‘work on the report’ with ‘write the paragraph explaining the sales drop.’
